# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Use AGENTS.md as the canonical project instruction file.

Start with:
- coordination/CONTEXT.md
- coordination/WORK_QUEUE.md
- recent entries in coordination/AI_SYNC.md
- state/CURRENT.md
- docs/ROADMAP_1_TO_3.md

ChatGPT is the lead/reviewer and owns priority. Antigravity is the primary execution workhorse.

Keep integrations replaceable and do not add job-application automation that bypasses platform rules or anti-bot controls.

Do not invent candidate facts. Simulations must never masquerade as real external actions.
